reason: My clients buy off the architect's drawings and my photos of finished homes, and nobody has ever asked to walk through a house before we build it. At 1-6 homes a year, $1,500 a home comes straight out of my margin for something I haven't been asked for.
objection: Is $1,500 a home worth it on our margins when buyers have never asked for this? Revision rounds at $500 also worry me, since clients change things constantly.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing that clients sign faster or make fewer costly change orders because of it, or an architect I work with offering to bundle it into their fee so it doesn't come out of my pocket.
